summary: Iteration 2 focused on the new LEAD→BRAND→PROPOSAL→CAMPAIGN→INVOICE→PAYMENT modules. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_billing.py (28 pytest cases) covering meta constants, business settings, proposal generator math (20x59x7=₹8,260, exposure 14), proposal PDF, convert-to-campaign (idempotent), campaign CRUD + display_status/days_left, invoice auto numbering QW-XXX (uniqueness/sequence), manual number + 409 duplicate, payments (partial→paid, balance), invoice PDF, business dashboard (6 slots), backup, reset guards (403 employee / 400 wrong confirm), unauthenticated 401s. Full suite (backend_test.py + test_billing.py) = 82/82 passed. Frontend (public URL, Playwright): admin dashboard quick actions + all 6 business stat cards + expiring alert with 'Contact for Renewal'; proposal generator preset 14_days (paid=14/rate=39 → ₹10,920) and manual 20×59×7 → ₹8,260 / 14-day exposure; save → card QP-007; proposal PDF preview (popup, HTTP 200) + download (615KB, %PDF); convert-to-campaign; Campaigns page (14 cards, Active/Expired/Expiring Soon + days-left); camp-invoice → QW-022 toast; Invoices page (auto QW-023, inv-total ₹1,950, PDF preview/download, partial payment → 'Partially Paid' + Balance ₹950, full → 'Paid', duplicate number → 409 + error toast, modal stays open); Settings Business/Banking persistence after reload, Templates & Data tabs, backup JSON download (26 invoices); Reset Demo Data (confirm disabled for 'reset', enabled for 'RESET', wipe → 0 brands/0 campaigns/0-6 slots/₹0, next invoice restarts at QW-001 and creation works); access control (employee redirected from /campaigns, /invoices, /settings to /, can open /proposals, no reset UI); regression: leads(34), pipeline, analytics, customers, call-log workflow ('Log' → outcome modal → Call logged), industry dropdown with 25 industries, mobile viewport. Demo data restored after the destructive reset test (34 leads, 4 campaigns, QW-001..004, counter=4, business settings back to defaults).

minor.issue: Only require get_current_user — an employee token can create/list invoices and campaigns even though the UI blocks those routes for employees (verified: employee POST /api/invoices → 200, got QW-005). Should be require_admin (or role-scoped) to match the UI access model.
amount_paid is overwritten with the posted value instead of accumulating, and no payment history is stored, so multiple part-payments must be summed by the client and cannot be audited.
No delete endpoints exist for invoices or campaigns — a mistakenly created invoice/campaign can only be removed by wiping everything via reset-demo.

No brute-force protection: 6 consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401 with no lockout/throttling (playbook item 4 not implemented; the app uses Bearer JWT so httpOnly-cookie playbook items do not apply). bcrypt hashing itself is correct ($2b$ via bcrypt.hashpw).

Guard is 'skip if any campaign OR invoice exists', so after a reset + one real invoice, a backend restart re-seeds 34 demo leads but never restores demo campaigns/proposals — dashboard then shows leads with 0 campaigns. Informational, but inconsistent partial re-seed.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile nav always renders EMP_NAV (AppLayout.jsx line ~108), so an admin on mobile has no bottom-nav access to Proposals/Campaigns/Invoices/Settings — only reachable via Profile → admin links. Same gap reported in iteration 1.
Employees can open /proposals (route allowed, page works) but there is no sidebar/mobile link to it, so it is only reachable by typing the URL.
React console error on open: 'A component is changing an uncontrolled input to be controlled' (invoice number / date fields initialised as undefined before next-number fetch resolves).
Brand Name / Mobile / Contact inputs have no data-testid (only lead-industry-select does), forcing positional selectors in tests.
Campaign status pills are plain markup without data-testid (no status-pill-* testid as on lead cards), so status assertions rely on card text.

issues: Date fields use native browser date pickers (type=date, shown as mm/dd/yyyy US format) instead of the shadcn calendar; US ordering is odd for an India/₹ product
The primary 'Call' control is an <a href=tel:> that only dials; call logging is on the secondary 'Log' button — discoverability of the call-outcome flow is low (functional, not a bug)

action_items: Restrict invoice/campaign create (and ideally list) endpoints to admin — employee tokens can currently create invoices/campaigns via API.
Render ADMIN_NAV (or an admin-aware subset) in the mobile bottom nav so admins can reach Proposals/Campaigns/Invoices/Settings on phones.
Add a nav entry to /proposals for employees, or remove the employee route.
Make payment recording additive with a payment history, and add delete endpoints for invoices/campaigns.
Initialise InvoiceModal inputs with '' to remove the controlled/uncontrolled React warning.
Optional: replace native date inputs with the shadcn calendar / dd-mm-yyyy formatting.
critical_code_review_comments: billing.py: create_invoice/create_campaign/list endpoints use get_current_user while /dashboard/business and reset use require_admin — inconsistent authorization surface for the same feature area.
billing.py record_payment sets amount_paid = posted value (not +=), so the API cannot express incremental payments; also no payments collection for audit.
AppLayout.jsx duplicates nav rendering and hardcodes EMP_NAV for mobile — single source of truth (nav = isAdmin ? ADMIN_NAV : EMP_NAV) should be used in both desktop and mobile branches.
seed.py seed_billing_demo guard (campaigns>0 OR invoices>0) makes re-seed non-deterministic after a partial reset.

success_rate.backend: 100% (82/82 pytest cases pass; 5 non-failing authz/design gaps reported)
success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all new-module flows and access control pass; mobile admin nav gap + minor console warning)

rca_of_the_issue: Authorization gap RCA: billing.py declares create/list handlers with Depends(get_current_user) whereas the frontend gates /invoices, /campaigns, /settings behind an admin route guard only; therefore server-side role enforcement is missing and an employee JWT can POST /api/invoices (reproduced → 200, QW-005). Mobile nav RCA: AppLayout.jsx computes `nav = isAdmin ? ADMIN_NAV : EMP_NAV` for the sidebar but the mobile bar maps EMP_NAV unconditionally (line ~108), so the new admin modules are invisible on small screens.
